task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab and place two the sports shoe white and black in the orange cardboard shoe-box, tips left.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架抓取并将两双运动鞋白色和黑色放入橙色纸板鞋盒中，尖端左侧。
